summary.prose: Building this fix teaches the docs migrator to correct each artifact's stored label, date anchor and standalone flag along with moving its markdown. The planner gains a list of exact metadata rewrites and label-line edits that the dry run prints, and the apply step writes them inside the existing per-work-item commits and all-or-nothing rollback. The work closes with a dry run over this repo shown to the user before anything is applied.

Export epicShortName (define.ts) and hldShortName (hld.ts) unchanged in behaviour so the planner can rebuild DEF/HLD H1 lines with the renderers' own rule.

tasks.title: planMigration computes per-member field rewrites
tasks.summary: Inside the group member loop, compare each mappable member of an anchored group against the group: epicSlug set to the label only when the label came from a real slug source (slug !== undefined) and differs from the stored slug; epicCreatedAt set to the group anchor only when deriveWorkItemIdentity(hash, memberAnchor).epicSegment differs from the group's (memberAnchor = epicCreatedAt ?? createdAt; an unparsable or missing member anchor counts as different); standalone: true when the group is standalone and the RAW stored meta.standalone is not true (readMeta surfaces the raw flag separately from the SPEC-forced Artifact.standalone). Members that are unmappable get no rewrite. Emits one MetaRewrite per member with a non-empty `set`, in group order, including already-placed (non-moving) members.

tasks.summary: For members whose epicSlug is rewritten, plan exact whole-line edits against the md's post-move path (the move's `to`, else its current mdPath), building each old line exactly as the renderer did from the stored meta: PLAN/LLD '**Epic:** `${String(oldSlug)}`' (the literal 'undefined' when no slug was stored) -> new; EXT '# Extend: <old> — <title>' and '> **Extends Epic `<old>`** — ...' -> new; DEF '# Epic: <epicShortName(old)>' and HLD '# HLD: <hldShortName(old)>' -> new, computed by calling the exported helpers on the parsed artifact with old vs new meta. No md edit for BUILD/CR/TESTS/SPEC/ISSUE. For relabelled members carrying body.companions, list each companion relPath in companionNotes (pages are not edited).

tasks.title: applyMigration applies metaRewrites inside the per-group commits and rollback
tasks.summary: Change the zero-moves early return to require no moves AND no metaRewrites. After link rewrites, for each MetaRewrite: JSON.parse the artifact (error names the artifact), set only the listed meta fields, write back as JSON.stringify(..., null, 2) + '\n', git add; for each md edit, count exact whole-line matches of `from` in the file (error naming file + line when not exactly one), replace, git add. Commit per group with the moves' paths plus the group's JSON and md paths; groups with only rewrites get a 'chore(docs): realign <hash> artifact labels' commit. With zero moves the vacated set is empty and link validation still runs. All inside the existing try so failures reset --hard to startSha. Narrow the existing '.insrc/artifacts byte-identical after apply' test assertion to consistent members, since stale members are now expected to change.
